summary: The figure shows the changing composition of causes of DALYs (Disability-Adjusted Life Years) across WHO regions and globally from 2000 to 2048. Noncommunicable diseases increase substantially in all regions over time, becoming the dominant cause by 2048. Communicable, maternal, perinatal, and nutritional conditions decrease markedly, especially in the African Region and globally. Injuries remain relatively stable with slight variations across regions.
